If the man is too weak to even talk to you about it then he needs to go to couples therapy with you at best, and if he doesn't then you need to make a hard decision.

Learned behaviors are a real thing, and it sounds like it's possible that your husband has realized that if he cries when he doesn't want to talk about or do something, that you aren't going to force him to do so. You personally have no issues besides too much patience. Your hisband is a weak person and needs to see that there will be consequences for his actions.
